name: paymenter_renew_service
description: Extend the validity period and renew a service by adding days or setting a new expiration date.

service_id.description: Numeric ID of the service to renew.

days.description: Number of days to extend from current expiration date (e.g. 30).

new_expires_at.description: Explicit new expiration ISO 8601 date-time string.
